To address this problem, the authors propose a novel approach that involves assembling novel transcripts in the context of an existing annotation. The authors develop a new method that uses a reference annotation-based transcript assembly strategy to identify novel transcripts. The main finding of this paper is that the proposed approach can effectively identify novel transcripts in annotated genomes, which has significant implications for our understanding of the transcriptome and its role in various biological processes.
